title: Vision Plans Stand-Alone Fitting Cost: Specialty Contracted Fee and Standard Fitting Benefit
content:
**Provider reimbursement note — stand-alone contact-lens fittings, Vision Plans**

How the member share of a stand-alone fitting is worked out depends on its kind and location.

**Specialty fitting, participating independent practice.** It is first priced at its contracted fee: the billed charge less 10% of it. The member pays the part of that contracted fee above the combined fitting allowance, never below 0.00.

**Specialty fitting, participating retail-chain location.** It receives no fitting allowance and costs the member its contracted fee, the billed charge less 10% of it.

**Every other fitting.** It follows the fitting benefit as stated for its kind: the member pays the part of the billed charge above the combined fitting allowance, never below 0.00, and for a standard fitting at most the plan's standard fitting maximum.

| | Independent practice | Retail-chain location |
|---|---|---|
| Specialty fitting | Contracted fee less the combined allowance (not below 0.00) | Contracted fee; no allowance |
| Standard fitting | Billed charge less the combined allowance (not below 0.00), at most the standard maximum | Same |

*Hypothetical figures.* A specialty fitting billed 214.70 has a contracted fee of 193.23. At an independent practice with a combined allowance of 135.00 the member pays 58.23; at a retail-chain location the member pays 193.23. A specialty fitting billed 92.40 at an independent practice with a combined allowance of 135.00 costs the member 0.00.
